name: District 7 Quarantine
summary: A sealed arcology district where the Bloom grows through the walls.
environmentPrompt: Overgrown arcology, fungal Bloom growth, dim emergency lighting.

pointsOfInterest.name: Scavenging run
pointsOfInterest.summary: A standing run through the ruins for supplies and scrap.

rumors: Quarantine wardens stopped answering the radio three nights ago.
Someone is selling clean air filters out of Block C. The filters are not clean.
The spores bloom brighter near the old seed vault. Locals avoid the east stairwell.

name: Corridor K-12
summary: A mining corridor of tunnels and half-powered machinery, behind its quota.
environmentPrompt: Mining tunnels, machinery, sparks and cold rock.

pointsOfInterest.name: Scavenging run
pointsOfInterest.summary: A standing run through the ruins for supplies and scrap.

rumors: The night shift never came up from level four. Their lamps are still lit.
Kestrel-Ward is counting the corridor as lost stock on paper already.
Drills keep running in the lower galleries with nobody at the controls.

name: The Ashway
summary: A dead highway lined with scavenger camps and burnt-out convoys.
environmentPrompt: Dead highway, ash drifts, scavenger camps.

pointsOfInterest.name: Scavenging run
pointsOfInterest.summary: A standing run through the ruins for supplies and scrap.

rumors: A convoy of sealed crates was left on the overpass. Three crews have gone to look.
Packs follow the highway at dusk. They are bigger than they used to be.
The marauders pay in old credit chips for anything that still runs.

name: Drowned Market
summary: A flooded commercial district; the stalls still open at dawn, for someone.
environmentPrompt: Flooded commercial district, neon in dark water.

pointsOfInterest.name: Scavenging run
pointsOfInterest.summary: A standing run through the ruins for supplies and scrap.

rumors: Traders say the lights under the water move when nobody is looking.
An Aurum broker is buying debts in the east arcade. Nobody sees him leave.
Something in the cold storage hums a tune from before the Bloom.

name: The Garden
summary: The epicenter of the Bloom, where the geometry stops agreeing with itself.
environmentPrompt: Bloom epicenter, wrong geometry, impossible light.

pointsOfInterest.name: Scavenging run
pointsOfInterest.summary: A standing run through the ruins for supplies and scrap.

rumors: The map of the Garden is different every time it is drawn.
Off-spec units went in with their limiters on. Their signals still come out.
Nothing that goes in is quite the same on the way out.
